Class MessageEditCommand

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.chat.cmd.MessageEditCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
Command
public class MessageEditCommand extends Object implements Command
The MessageEditCommand type is the message edit command. The command revises one stored turn and does not send that turn to the model. A body on the same line is the new text. A sequence number with no body reads following lines until a line whose text is <.>. The command has no aliases.

    • execute

      public void execute(CommandContext ctx, String args) throws Exception
      The execute method revises one stored message or starts a multi-line read. If args is null or blank, the method throws Exception with the message Usage: message edit <seq>. The first token must be a decimal sequence number. If that token is not a number, the method throws the same usage exception. If the line has no text after the sequence number, the method calls CommandContext.collectMessageEdit(long) and returns. If the text after the sequence number is empty, the method throws Exception with the message An empty body is refused. Otherwise the method stores that text with
      invalid reference 
      ChatSession#editMessage
      and writes edited plus the sequence number. The written line ends with a carriage return and a line feed.
      Specified by:
      execute in interface Command
      Parameters:
      ctx - The shell resources for this connection.
      args - The remainder of the line after the command name.
      Throws:
      Exception - The usage was wrong, the body was empty, or the session rejected the edit.

    • joinBody

      public static String joinBody(String[] lines) throws Exception
      The joinBody method joins body lines into one string. A line whose text is <.> ends the body and is not included. A line whose text is . is body text. A null entry is treated as an empty line. Lines are joined with a newline character. If lines is null, the method throws Exception with the message An empty body is refused. If no body line was kept, or the joined text is empty, the method throws the same exception.
      Parameters:
      lines - The lines after the bare sequence number, including the terminator.
      Returns:
      The joined body.
      Throws:
      Exception - The body was missing or empty.
